note: Synthetic company data. Design trimmed to 2 steps and 2 rows per list; errors are those of the full run at the final throw (older validation rules).

design.processName: Job-work subcontracting at Chakan: issuing forged blanks to heat-treatment vendors, receiving them back at Chakan or Bhosari, and settling the vendor

keyDesignDecisions.topic: Which system holds the stock at the job-worker and posts the issue, return and rejection

options.name: SAP holds the job-work stock as subcontract stock, held in the LLP's books and relieved only by these postings
options.pros: One authoritative balance per vendor, challan and heat; ITC-04, ageing and reconciliation all read from the same postings.
options.cons: The Chakan store keeper and the gate must work in SAP from day one; no posting means the truck does not move.

options.name: Tally for the LLP stays the book of record for job-work stock for one year, SAP is fed by interface
options.pros: Least disruption to the store and finance while the LLP runs parallel.
options.cons: Keeps a second balance to reconcile, so the unreconciled-stock problem survives the go-live; duplicate master data.

options.name: SAP posts the movements, Tally receives them as a posting mirror for the LLP
options.pros: SAP is authoritative while statutory books of the LLP are still fed.
options.cons: Mirror interface to build, test and reconcile monthly; extra effort inside the fixed budget.

keyDesignDecisions.recommendation: SAP holds the job-work stock as subcontract stock, held in the LLP's books and relieved only by these postings
keyDesignDecisions.rationale: Unreconciled material at vendors (INR 3.2 crore qualification) and the 100% zero-unreconciled-stock target only become measurable if one system posts the issue, the return and the rejection. The parallel Tally run for the LLP is a reporting mirror only; its retirement date and reconciliation method are pending IQ-27 and must be settled before go-live.

keyDesignDecisions.topic: How the direct return to Bhosari is booked across the two legal entities

options.name: Bhosari posts the receipt as a cross-entity supply out of the LLP, with an intercompany billing document
options.pros: Stock lands where it is consumed; both GSTINs and the ITC-04 of the LLP are relieved by a document.
options.cons: Intercompany pricing rule and GST treatment need finance sign-off; heavier posting.

options.name: Chakan receives into its own stock first, then transfers inter-plant to Bhosari
options.pros: Simple, one owner of the vendor balance, challan always closes at Chakan.
options.cons: Adds a fictitious movement and transit time for material that physically never returns to Chakan.

options.name: Receipt stays at Chakan in the vendor's stock and Bhosari takes it out by a consumption note
options.cons: Bhosari would consume stock it does not own; breaks the books of the Pvt Ltd entity.

keyDesignDecisions.recommendation: Bhosari posts the receipt as a cross-entity supply out of the LLP, with an intercompany billing document
keyDesignDecisions.rationale: The receipt must relieve the LLP's stock at the vendor and land in Pvt Ltd, the entity that machines the parts. Which plant posts, in whose books vendor stock sits and how the supply is valued and reported is pending IQ-21, IQ-14 and JWK-OQ-4, so the recommendation applies once those are answered.

fitGap.justification: Standard subcontracting stock at the vendor, kept in company code 2000 per vendor, gives the reconciled balance the audit finding is about; no custom object is needed, only job-worker masters and the challan-based issue/return setup. It is not STANDARD because the balance must be monitored by a vendor ageing view, and the catalog carries no verified evidence, so a consultant must confirm the capability.
fitGap.validationReason: Confirm that S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition subcontracting stock at the vendor supports a per-vendor, per-challan balance view that can be reconciled to zero at close.

fitGap.justification: The system-generated job-work challan and the quarterly ITC-04 statement are delivered by standard subcontracting and GST reporting, configured for the LLP; the Excel register is retired rather than rebuilt. Nothing in the catalog evidences it, so validation is needed.
fitGap.validationReason: Confirm that the GST job-work challan document and the ITC-04 statement are available as standard in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2702 for India.

masterDataPrerequisites.object: Company codes and plants (1000 Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd with plants 1100 Bhosari, 1200 Hosur, 1300 Chennai warehouse; 2000 Shaktiman Forge LLP with plant 2100 Chakan)
masterDataPrerequisites.migrationSource: to be confirmed by the business (no legacy extract supplied)
masterDataPrerequisites.creationChannel: Configured once before cutover in the organisational structure set-up; not loaded as transaction data.
masterDataPrerequisites.governance: The CFO approves every organisational unit and its linkage; a plant cannot be activated without a company code and a fiscal year variant.

masterDataPrerequisites.object: Storage locations per plant (raw material, WIP, finished goods, quality hold, scrap)
masterDataPrerequisites.migrationSource: to be confirmed by the business
masterDataPrerequisites.creationChannel: Configured at set-up; the business supplies the location codes.
masterDataPrerequisites.governance: Adds or renames of storage locations need the plant head's approval; whether quality hold and scrap exist at every plant is still open (JWK-OQ-11).

dataMigration.object: Suppliers and vendors (6 job-workers, steel mills, 140+ consumable vendors) with MSME status
dataMigration.source: Tally ERP 9 vendor ledger and the purchasing list, cleansed by AP
dataMigration.approach: Extract, de-duplicate by GSTIN, cleanse MSME and bank data against Udyam and bank letters, load, reconcile counts and GSTINs to the Tally vendor ledger.
dataMigration.risk: Duplicate vendors with the same GSTIN create double MSME liability; cleanse before load.

dataMigration.object: Material master and heat-number batch characteristics for blanks and machined parts
dataMigration.source: Tally ERP 9 item master and the Excel part list
dataMigration.approach: Extract, cleanse descriptions and units, add batch management and the heat-number characteristic, load in a test run, then load to production and reconcile the item count.
dataMigration.risk: Parts created without batch management would silently break heat traceability; validate on a full extract before go-live.

cutover.activity: Freeze job-work movements at Chakan: no challan issue and no receipt posted until the load is reconciled.
cutover.risk: Trucks already on the road are missed; log them on the paper gate register and post after go-live against the original challan.

cutover.activity: Set up the company codes, plants, storage locations, MSME vendor masters, material masters with heat-number batches and the per-kg conditions in production.
cutover.risk: A missing storage location or MSME flag blocks the first posting; complete the set-up checklist before the freeze.

periodEndActivities.activity: Reconcile the subcontract stock at each of the six job-workers to the open challan balance and to the vendor statement, and clear differences by the step that owns the document.
Review the challan ageing list and escalate every open challan line approaching the GST one-year limit (alert at 150 days) to the plant head for closure.

interfaces.counterpartSystem: GST IRP and e-way bill portal (via a GSP)
interfaces.triggerFrequency: At each posted job-work challan and each dispatch billing document; volume from the approximately 70% of 900 tonnes a month that goes to job-workers (operating scale given, per-document count not provided)
interfaces.payload: Challan and invoice data for GST e-invoice and e-way bill generation, and the returned IRN and e-way bill number for the posted document
interfaces.validationReason: Confirm the GSP interface for e-invoice and e-way bill is available in Public Edition and whether each job-work challan movement needs its own e-way bill (JWK-OQ-3).

failureHandling.detection: A rejected or unanswered document shows in the interface monitor and the posted document keeps the not-generated status.
failureHandling.alerting: The finance coordinator gets an error list for every failed e-invoice or e-way bill.
failureHandling.rerun: Correct the master data or address and resend that one document from the posted source document.
failureHandling.idempotency: The document number and IRN already stored on the source document stop a second e-invoice from being raised.

interfaces.systemOfRecord: SAP for the posting; the IRP and e-way bill portal for the government registration

interfaces.counterpartSystem: Tata SupplierNet, Mahindra portal and the German Tier-1's email call-offs (customer portals / EDI-API)
interfaces.triggerFrequency: Monthly schedules from Tata and Mahindra, weekly call-offs for the German Tier-1, as the current trigger description gives
interfaces.payload: Delivery schedule quantities and dates per customer part, used to create and update customer scheduling agreements
interfaces.validationReason: Confirm the released scheduling-agreement intake interface for each customer portal and the EDI/API partner route within Public Edition.

failureHandling.detection: A schedule that fails validation is parked in the interface error queue with the reason and does not change the agreement.
failureHandling.alerting: The sales coordinator is alerted the same day the schedule fails.
failureHandling.rerun: The coordinator corrects the customer part or material mapping and replays the same file or message.
failureHandling.idempotency: The customer schedule number and version are matched against the stored agreement update so a repeated transmission does not double the requirement.

interfaces.systemOfRecord: SAP for the scheduling agreement; the customer portal for the schedule the customer publishes

kpis.name: Unreconciled stock at job-workers, in INR crore (value of open challan balance not explained by receipts, rejections or invoices, per month end)
kpis.baseline: not provided — current value to be measured by Plant Head Chakan from today's records before go-live
kpis.measuredFrom: Stock at vendor per open challan compared with the month-end reconciliation statement
kpis.validationReason: No verified catalog; confirm the standard stock-at-vendor and reconciliation view in Public Edition.

kpis.name: Month-end close duration in working days (from period end to the closed period, per month)
kpis.baseline: not provided — current value to be measured by Finance controller from today's records before go-live
kpis.measuredFrom: Close task list and the period-end reconciliation of job-worker balances
kpis.validationReason: The current 15-day close is in the business problem statement but not in the KPI baseline answer; confirm the measured baseline.

objectives.statement: Know, every day, exactly how much forged material sits at each of the six heat-treatment vendors per challan, part and heat number, so no material at a vendor is unaccounted for at close.
Give Tata and Hyundai 100% heat-number traceability from forging through the vendor and back to machining, so the business is not lost on PPAP/IATF grounds.

scopeStatements.statement: Issuing heat-numbered forged blanks from Chakan to the six heat-treatment and shot-blasting vendors on a system job-work challan, and receiving the treated blanks back at Chakan.
scopeStatements.reason: This is the core of the stated job-work flow, which starts at Chakan forging and ends when the treated blanks come back.

scopeStatements.statement: Sales, MRP, dispatch, steel-price variation billing and customer returns for the machined parts, because the vendor flow is driven by customer schedules.
scopeStatements.reason: The module scope names sales, schedule agreements, dispatch, e-invoicing, MRP and standard costing, and the requirement traceability carries these requirements into this design.

reports.name: Stock at job-worker report by vendor, part and heat
reports.purpose: Lets the Plant Head Chakan see what material each of the six job-workers still holds, so the unreconciled vendor stock is measured and chased rather than discovered at audit.
reports.realization: Standard subcontracting stock view per vendor with heat-number batch, proposed to be validated against the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition scope before build.
reports.validationReason: No verified SAP catalog is available for this release; confirm a standard stock-at-vendor view by batch exists or is covered by configuration.

reports.name: ITC-04 statement from posted challans and returns
reports.purpose: Gives finance the quarterly statement of challans issued and returns received to file, replacing the Excel register; scope and format to be confirmed with the tax team.
reports.realization: Report built on posted job-work challan, receipt and rejection documents; proposed as an analytical view to be confirmed.
reports.validationReason: No verified SAP catalog; confirm the standard ITC-04 output for this release or that a key-user analytical view is needed.

endToEndTests.valueStream: Forged blanks out to a heat-treatment vendor and back to Chakan plant stock, then invoiced
endToEndTests.given: Plant 2100 has 1,000 kg of crankshaft blanks in stock as a confirmed heat-numbered batch and one job-worker is set up for heat treatment at a per-kg rate
endToEndTests.when: The store keeper issues 1,000 kg on a system job-work challan, the vendor returns 600 kg in two lots over three weeks and 20 kg of cracked pieces are recorded as scrapped at the vendor, and the monthly per-kg invoice is verified
endToEndTests.then: The vendor's stock balance reads 380 kg against the open challan, the challan is closed by receipts plus recorded rejections, the invoice posts only when the match passes, and the stock-at-vendor and heat traceability reports show the lot and its heat at every stage

endToEndTests.valueStream: Direct return of treated blanks from the job-worker to Bhosari
endToEndTests.given: Plant 2100 has issued 800 kg of gear blanks under one Chakan challan in company code 2000, and the vendor ships the treated blanks straight to plant 1100 Bhosari in company code 1000
endToEndTests.when: Bhosari posts the receipt for 500 kg against the Chakan challan with the heat number, and the cross-entity supply between the two company codes is recorded; which plant posts and how it is valued is pending JWK-OQ-4
endToEndTests.then: The Bhosari receipt is visible against the original Chakan challan, the remaining 300 kg still shows as stock at the vendor in the LLP's books, and the ITC-04 statement reflects the challan and its return; the posting plant and valuation are held pending JWK-OQ-4

transitions.event: Goods issue to the job-worker's subcontract stock posted and challan number issued
First partial receipt posted against the challan line
Received quantity plus recorded rejections equal the issued quantity

editLockRules.locked: Vendor, part, heat-number batch, quantity and weight
editLockRules.stillEditable: Open quantity falls only through receipts and recorded rejections; a wrong challan is corrected by the step that owns it
Nothing; later differences are cleared in the period-end reconciliation

transitions.event: Receipt keyed against the open challan line with the heat-number batch
Inspection lot raised by the receipt is decided
Chakan goods receipt posted from the vendor's subcontract stock

editLockRules.locked: Part, heat-number batch and received quantity
editLockRules.stillEditable: Nothing on the receipt; a wrong line is corrected against the same challan line by the store keeper

configurationCatalogue.name: Organisation code 2100 (Chakan plant) and organisation code 2000 (Shaktiman Forge LLP company code)
configurationCatalogue.purpose: The unit that issues the blanks and carries the stock at the vendor; defined in the organisation structure register.
configurationCatalogue.note: Codes come from the company-context answers; the confirmation of their SAP entry is with the administrator.

configurationCatalogue.name: Organisation code 1100 (Bhosari plant) and organisation code 1000 (Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd company code)
configurationCatalogue.purpose: The receiving plant and company code for lots delivered directly to Bhosari and for the cross-entity supply.
configurationCatalogue.note: Which plant and company code posts a direct return is open under IQ-21 and IQ-14.

roles.name: Organisational master data administrator
roles.responsibilities: Creates and maintains company codes, plants, storage locations and the stock view per job-worker.

roles.name: Materials master data steward
roles.responsibilities: Creates forged blank material masters with heat-number batch management and the job-worker vendor masters.

sodAssessments.description: The Chakan production supervisor decides and records the rejection of vendor-held pieces while the Chakan store keeper controls the challan and receipt quantities, so the same side both reports the loss and closes the challan.
sodAssessments.mitigation: The Chakan finance controller reconciles open challans to receipts and recorded rejections at every close; the plant head releases rejections above a value the business still has to set (pending JWK-OQ-9). The release authority for a job-work issue stays open (pending JWK-OQ-10).

sodAssessments.description: The same team that receives the vendor's monthly invoice also checks it against returns, so a wrong processed weight is only caught by a second pair of eyes outside accounts payable.
sodAssessments.mitigation: The invoice stays blocked until the match of challan, posted return quantity and weight and the per-kg price condition passes, and the plant head releases it in the system; the value threshold of that release is pending JWK-OQ-7. The Chakan finance controller reviews the matched position at close.

controlMappings.realization: A triplicate book challan and an Excel register give way to a system-generated GST job-work challan per issue and an ITC-04 statement built from posted challans, receipts and rejections.
The heat number is a mandatory batch on every receipt, so a receipt without it cannot be posted and the traceable heat is kept for Tata and Hyundai parts.

steps.title: Set up the two company codes, plants, storage locations and job-worker stock
steps.trigger: The job-work subcontracting design is approved for build and the two legal entities, Chakan and Bhosari site layouts, storage areas and the six heat-treatment job-workers are known; set-up is released by the Plant Head Chakan.
steps.interimProcess: Chakan and Bhosari keep issuing blanks against the store keeper's manual challan and the finance Excel ITC-04 register until this set-up is complete; the LLP runs Tally in parallel for one year, and until JWK-OQ-11 fixes a retirement date and reconciliation, balances are compared with the Excel challan sheet kept by the stores clerk.
inputDocuments: Approved general-ledger and company structure for Shaktiman Forge LLP and Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd, giving the company code numbers 2000 and 1000 and the plant/storage location naming
Site layout of Chakan plant 2100 and Bhosari plant 1100 listing raw material, WIP, finished goods, quality hold and scrap areas
List of the six heat-treatment and shot-blasting job-workers with GSTIN, MSME/Udyam status and contract terms
Forged blank part list with heat-number marking scheme required by Tata and Hyundai
GSTIN and GST registration details of company codes 1000 and 2000
outputDocuments: Configured company codes 2000 and 1000 with their plants 2100 and 1100 (and 1200 and 1300 where they belong to company code 1000)
Storage location list per plant for raw material, WIP, finished goods, quality hold and scrap
Subcontracting stock view configuration per job-worker supplier
Material master records for forged blanks with batch (heat-number) management
Vendor master records for the six job-workers with MSME classification flag
Set-up verification sheet listing every organisation unit, storage location and master record created

actions.operation: Create company code 2000 for Shaktiman Forge LLP with the local currency and the country/India settings the business confirms, and company code 1000 for Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd.
Assign plant 2100 Chakan to company code 2000 and plants 1100 Bhosari and 1200 Hosur, plus warehouse 1300, to company code 1000; confirm the plant addresses and GSTIN of each plant.

Create the storage location list for plant 2100 and plant 1100 covering raw material, WIP, finished goods, quality hold and scrap; whether quality hold and scrap need their own storage location in every plant is held pending JWK-OQ-11 and recorded as a to-be-confirmed item on the set-up sheet.

Create one vendor master per heat-treatment and shot-blasting job-worker, flagging the MSME classification, GSTIN and the supplier role used for subcontracting, so that the payable and the MSME due date can later be derived from this master.

Create or extend the forged blank material master in plant 2100 with batch management switched on so a heat number can be entered as the batch at forging confirmation, and with the subcontracting procurement view; the batch number itself is not created here.

Set up the stock view that will hold blanks at a job-worker in company code 2000's books as subcontract stock, and record the plant at which that stock is held; for returns to Bhosari the plant that posts the receipt and the books that carry the stock are held pending JWK-OQ-4 and are not configured as decided.
Check every organisation unit and master record created and hand the verification sheet to the Plant Head Chakan; nothing is posted and no stock document is created by this set-up.

exceptions.condition: A needed storage location for quality hold or scrap cannot be confirmed because the plant layout does not settle it
exceptions.response: Record the item on the verification sheet as provisional with the question it waits for (JWK-OQ-11) and do not create an interim code; the affected receipts keep using the confirmed locations only.

exceptions.condition: A job-worker vendor is presented without MSME/Udyam status or GSTIN
exceptions.response: Do not activate the vendor for job-work; return the vendor sheet to procurement for completion so that the MSME due date and the GST reporting can later be derived.

exceptions.condition: A forged blank material is requested for job-work without batch management
exceptions.response: Reject the material from the set-up and raise it to the quality head and the materials master data steward, because a heat number could then not be recorded at receipt.

masterData.object: Company code 2000 (Shaktiman Forge LLP) and company code 2000 (Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd)
Plant 2100 Chakan, plant 2100 Bhosari, plant 1100 Hosur and warehouse 1300

fields: base unit of measure in kilograms
payment terms basis for the 45-day MSME limit

effects.inventory: None: this set-up creates organisation units, storage locations and master records only; no stock quantity and no stock category is changed.
effects.financial: None: no financial document exists after this set-up. The set-up determines in whose books stock will later sit (company code 2000 for blanks at the job-worker) and from which vendor master the MSME due date will be derived, but it posts nothing.
effects.ownership: Ownership of the forged blanks is recorded as belonging to company code 2000 (Shaktiman Forge LLP) while they are at a job-worker, separate from the vendor's custody; for returns at Bhosari the owning entity and posting plant stay undecided pending JWK-OQ-4.
effects.accountingEntry: None: the set-up of company codes, plants, storage locations, batch management and vendor masters creates no accounting document. The company codes' standard account determination, which later drives the subcontract postings of the issue, receipt, rejection and invoice steps, is activated here and its account categories are owned by the Finance lead.

steps.addedValue: The two legal entities, their plants and all storage areas, the job-worker vendors and the heat-number capability exist once, in one system, before any blank is issued. This removes the single largest cause of the audit qualification: today the material at vendors is not recorded in any system and the challan lives only on paper and in an Excel sheet, so there is no place to hold stock at a vendor. After this set-up every later challan, receipt, rejection and invoice can point at a real plant, storage location and supplier, and the blank can carry a heat number from forging onwards.

businessRules.condition: The set-up applies to the operation
businessRules.response: The set-up covers company code 2000 (Shaktiman Forge LLP) with plant 2100 Chakan, and company code 2000 (Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd) with plants 1100 Bhosari and 1200 Hosur and warehouse 1300. Hosur assembly and shipping stay outside this job-work flow pending JWK-OQ-4's relation to IQ-18; Hosur is configured only as an existing unit of company code 1000.

businessRules.condition: A forged blank material is created or extended in plant 2100
businessRules.response: Batch management must be active on it, because the heat number is created as the batch at forging confirmation and is mandatory on every receipt at Chakan and at Bhosari. A material without batch management is rejected from the set-up sheet.

It is created with a name in words and no invented code beyond the plant numbers given (2100, 1100, 1200) and warehouse 1300; a location for raw material, WIP, finished goods, quality hold and scrap is listed per plant, and quality hold and scrap are marked provisional pending JWK-OQ-11.

businessRules.condition: A job-worker vendor master is created
businessRules.response: The MSME classification and GSTIN are recorded, because the vendor payable is created only by the invoice verification step (JWK-6-1) and its 45-day MSME limit is driven from this master; a vendor without MSME classification cannot be used for job-work in company code 2000.

businessRules.condition: The stock view for blanks at a job-worker is configured
businessRules.response: It is configured so the issued blanks stay in company code 2000's books as stock at the vendor until a receipt or a recorded rejection relieves them, and the owning entity and custody are kept separate: the vendor holds the material, the LLP owns it.

businessRules.condition: A return is expected at Bhosari instead of Chakan
businessRules.response: The set-up records no decided answer: which plant posts the receipt, in whose books the stock at the vendor sits and how the cross-entity supply is valued is held pending JWK-OQ-4, and the Bhosari configuration is left open until that decision is approved.

It is confirmed on the verification sheet by the Plant Head Chakan; only then may the issue, receipt, invoice-verification and monitoring steps rely on the units and masters, and no step may assume an organisation unit that is not on that sheet.

businessRules.condition: The parallel Tally run of the LLP is still active
businessRules.response: A retirement date and a reconciliation of balances with SAP are not set by this set-up; they remain held pending JWK-OQ-11, and the set-up sheet records the parallel run as a live dependency of company code 2000.

implementation.detail: No verified SAP Cloud Public Edition 2702 catalogue was supplied for this design, so every object below is to be validated. Proposed: company code, plant and storage location set-up for 2000/2100 and 1000/1100-1200/1300; batch management on the forged blank material; supplier master with MSME indicator; subcontract stock indicator for stock at the job-worker. Validation points: which app or transaction is used for each unit; whether Public Cloud allows separate storage locations for quality hold and scrap in every plant (JWK-OQ-11); Bhosari posting plant and owning entity (JWK-OQ-4).

acceptanceTests.given: The approved ledger and site structure gives company code 2000 for Shaktiman Forge LLP and company code 2000 for Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd, and the six job-workers are supplied with GSTIN and MSME status
acceptanceTests.when: The organisational master data administrator creates the company codes, assigns plant 2100 Chakan to 2000 and plants 2100 and 1200 plus warehouse 1300 to 1000, creates the storage locations and the six vendor masters, sets batch management on the forged blank material, and the Plant Head Chakan signs the verification sheet
acceptanceTests.then: The verification sheet lists two company codes, plant 2100 under 2000, plants 1100 and 1200 and warehouse 1300 under 1000, a storage location list per plant, one MSME-flagged vendor per job-worker and a batch-managed forged blank material, and no stock or accounting document exists in the system

acceptanceTests.given: One job-worker vendor is supplied without MSME/Udyam status and one forged blank material is requested without batch management
acceptanceTests.then: Neither is activated: the vendor is returned for completion and the material is rejected with a note to the materials master data steward, both items appear as open on the verification sheet, and every other vendor and material is created normally

acceptanceTests.given: The plant layout does not settle whether quality hold and scrap need their own storage locations
acceptanceTests.when: The administrator creates the storage locations for plant 2100 and plant 1100
acceptanceTests.then: The confirmed raw material, WIP and finished goods locations are created, quality hold and scrap are recorded as provisional against JWK-OQ-11 with no invented code, and the Plant Head Chakan receives the verification sheet naming that open point

steps.title: Plan forging from the machining requirement and confirm blanks by heat number
steps.trigger: The weekly machining plan from the Bhosari planner creates a blank requirement by part number for the Chakan forging shop.
inputDocuments: Weekly machining plan for Bhosari stating the blank requirement by part number
Forging order for plant 2100 Chakan in company code 2000
Steel billet rate contract under which the input billet is bought
Forging confirmation record for the completed blank quantity
Heat number recorded at forging (one heat number per forging lot)
outputDocuments: Blank material document confirming the forged blanks into Chakan stock in plant 2100 with the heat-number batch
Batch record per heat number, dated at forging confirmation
Open forged-blank stock quantity per part and heat number available for issue to a job-worker
Heat-number traceability record linking each blank lot to the Bhosari blank requirement

actions.operation: Release the weekly machining plan as the demand that drives the blank requirement for plant 2100; the part numbers and quantities are taken as planned. What else the plan must contain, and who approves it, is held pending IQ-6.
Explode the blank requirement into a planned forging order per part number for Chakan; the forging lot size follows the source-defined blank quantity and is not set by this design, pending IQ-7.
Convert the planned order into the Chakan forging order and confirm the forging operation for the blanks actually forged, in pieces as produced; the billet input comes from the rate contract.
Enter the heat number for the forging lot and record the forged quantity, heat basis and heat treatment status against the batch as required for downstream receipt at Chakan and Bhosari.

Post the forging confirmation so the blanks exist in Chakan stock in plant 2100 under company code 2000, with the heat-number batch, and become available for the job-work issue; no vendor stock entry is created here.
fields: stock type and storage location for forged blanks
weight in kg (to be recorded per lot)

exceptions.condition: The heat number of a forging lot is not recorded or is recorded twice wrongly
exceptions.response: The confirmation is held and the Production supervisor Chakan obtains the correct heat number from the forging record before posting; the blanks are not released to the job-worker without it. Owner: Production supervisor Chakan.

exceptions.condition: The Bhosari planner changes the blank requirement after the forging order is confirmed
exceptions.response: The plan change updates the remaining open order only; the posted blanks and their heat number are untouched. A reduction below the confirmed quantity needs the Bhosari planner's written change, owner: Bhosari planner, with the resulting overstock of blanks reviewed by the Production supervisor Chakan.

exceptions.condition: Confirmation is attempted without the forging order or without a heat number
exceptions.response: The system refuses the confirmation; the Production supervisor Chakan creates the forging order from the released machining plan or completes the heat number first. Owner: Production supervisor Chakan.

exceptions.condition: The heat-number batch exists but the blanks are not yet forged into stock
exceptions.response: No blank is posted and nothing is issued to a job-worker; the pending forging is reported to the Bhosari planner as a shortage and stays open on the forging order. Owner: Production supervisor Chakan.

masterData.object: Bill of material for the forged blank
Forging work centre and routing at plant 2100

effects.inventory: The forged blank quantity appears as Chakan own stock in plant 2100 under company code 2000, held per part number and per heat-number batch, and becomes selectable for the job-work issue. The billet stock consumed by forging falls by the input quantity. No stock at a vendor is created here.
effects.financial: The forged blanks are valued as produced stock in Chakan (production output), and the billet input is consumed from billet stock. No vendor cost, no job-work charge and no customer revenue arise in this step. A cost estimate basis for these blanks is not given by any source and is held pending JWK-OQ-2.
effects.ownership: The blanks are owned by company code 2000 (Shaktiman Forge LLP) in Chakan custody throughout this step. Custody passes to a job-worker only later, at the job-work issue step JWK-3-1, and ownership stays with company code 2000 there as well.
effects.accountingEntry: Proposed, to be validated: the forging confirmation posts a goods receipt of the forged blanks (debit inventory - finished or semi-finished blank stock at plant 2100) against the forging consumption of the billet (credit inventory - raw material billet stock); the document is the material document of the forging confirmation. The production-cost side of the confirmation (production output against production cost accounts) follows the costing policy that is not given by any source and is held pending JWK-OQ-2 and must be confirmed in the fit-to-standard workshop.

steps.addedValue: The forging plan stops being a separate Excel sheet: every forged blank exists in SAP with its heat number the moment it is confirmed, so the job-work issue has a document to point at and the heat number that must appear on every return at Chakan and Bhosari is created once, at the forging lot, instead of being carried on paper.

businessRules.condition: The weekly machining plan is released for a part number at Bhosari
businessRules.response: The blank requirement for Chakan is derived from that plan against plant 2100 stock and open orders; the forging order is created only for the net requirement. The remaining content of the machining plan and its approval are held pending IQ-6.

The confirmation posts the forged quantity into Chakan stock in plant 2100 under company code 2000 and creates the batch carrying the heat number; a confirmation without a heat number is not accepted. The status of the heat number is proposed design: it is set to registered at forging confirmation, as no current-state record documents it.

businessRules.condition: A heat number is used on more than one forging lot in the same period
businessRules.response: Proposed design control: the batch keeps the heat number and the forging lot and date so that each lot stays separately traceable; the rule is not an approved customer policy.

businessRules.condition: Fewer pieces are forged than the order quantity
businessRules.response: Only the forged quantity is confirmed and posted; the remainder stays open on the forging order and returns to planning. A later confirmation for the same order is a new forging lot with its own heat number.

businessRules.condition: The forged quantity is more than the order quantity
businessRules.response: The over-quantity is booked to the same part and heat-number batch and flagged to the Production supervisor Chakan; the tolerance that allows it is not given by any source, and no tolerance is applied until the business provides one. Proposed: the excess is held in Chakan stock, not scrapped or written off, until the production supervisor decides.

businessRules.condition: A confirmation was posted with the wrong quantity or the wrong heat number
businessRules.response: The Production supervisor Chakan corrects it before any material is issued to a job-worker. Once the blank has been issued to a job-worker, the correction is not made here: the release, stock and accounting consequences are decided by the job-work issue step JWK-3-1, and this step never posts a counter-posting against the issue step's posting.

businessRules.condition: The source document has been accepted by the system and the response is lost to the user
businessRules.response: The Production supervisor Chakan first checks whether the confirmation exists before confirming again; if it exists it is not repeated. A repeated submission of the same forging order and forging lot is treated as replay of the original instruction, and a genuinely new lot is keyed as a new confirmation with its own heat number.

businessRules.condition: The forging order is cancelled after a partial confirmation
businessRules.response: Only the unconfirmed remainder is cancelled; the posted forged quantity and its heat-number batch stay in Chakan stock and remain available for issue. Reversal of a posted forging confirmation is not designed here and needs the lead role's approval (Production supervisor Chakan with the person responsible for the costing treatment, which is held pending JWK-OQ-2).
It applies to plant 2100 Chakan in company code 2000 only. Bhosari (plant 1100), Hosur and the Chennai warehouse are not covered; Hosur's boundary is held pending IQ-18.

businessRules.condition: The forged blanks are to be read together with the stock held at the job-workers
businessRules.response: This step posts only Chakan own stock; the stock at the six job-workers continues to be held in the vendor subcontract stock created by the job-work issue step JWK-3-1. The two stocks are never netted in this step.

implementation.detail: No verified SAP catalog was supplied for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2702, so no standard object is claimed: MRP-derived forging orders, production order confirmation and heat-number batch management must be confirmed in fit-to-standard. Validation points: confirm that the confirmed forging quantity can be restricted so only forged pieces are posted; that the heat number is mandatory at confirmation and carried to every receipt at Chakan and Bhosari; and that no negative-stock behaviour is introduced here, since that rule is held pending IQ-17 and belongs to the issue step.

acceptanceTests.given: The Bhosari planner releases a weekly machining plan requiring 400 blanks of part number P, and Chakan has no free blank stock for P
acceptanceTests.when: The Production supervisor Chakan confirms a forging lot of 400 pieces with heat number H-1001 and posts the confirmation
acceptanceTests.then: Chakan stock for part P in plant 2100 shows 400 pieces in batch H-1001, the batch carries heat number H-1001 and the lot date, and the 400 pieces are available for the job-work issue step; no stock at a vendor exists for P yet.

acceptanceTests.given: A forging order for 400 blanks of part P is partly forged and confirmed for 250 pieces with heat number H-1002
acceptanceTests.when: The Production supervisor Chakan confirms a second forging lot of 150 pieces with heat number H-1003
acceptanceTests.then: Two separate batches exist for P (250 pieces of H-1002 and 150 pieces of H-1003), the forging order is fully confirmed, and each batch remains separately selectable for issue.

acceptanceTests.given: A forging confirmation for 150 blanks of part P records 150 pieces but leaves the heat number empty
acceptanceTests.when: The Production supervisor Chakan tries to post the confirmation
acceptanceTests.then: The confirmation is refused, no blank stock is created for part P, no seller-side or vendor stock is affected, and the blanks cannot be selected at the job-work issue step until the heat number is entered and the confirmation posted.

acceptanceTests.given: A forging confirmation of 250 pieces with heat number H-1004 was posted but was recorded on the wrong part number, and nothing has yet been issued to a job-worker
acceptanceTests.when: The Production supervisor Chakan corrects the confirmation for the forging lot
acceptanceTests.then: The correction is made in this step before any issue: the 250 pieces exist only under the correct part with batch H-1004, and no counter-posting to the job-work issue step exists because no issue has been posted.

acceptanceTests.given: The Production supervisor Chakan submitted a confirmation of 400 pieces for forging lot L-7 and the system response was lost, though the confirmation was in fact posted
acceptanceTests.when: The supervisor checks the forging order before submitting again
acceptanceTests.then: The existing confirmation for lot L-7 is found and not repeated; blank stock for the part remains 400 pieces of the one heat number, with no duplicate material document.

eliminatedAsIsSteps.reason: Machining at Bhosari after receipt lies outside this job-work flow, which ends when treated blanks are posted into Bhosari stock; the machining order then consumes them. No requirement is attached to it.
Matching customer receipts to open invoices stays with the finance workstream; no job-work requirement depends on it and it is not redesigned here.

coverage.rationale: Held pending JWK-OQ-6, JWK-OQ-10, IQ-17: Every issue posts to a named vendor's stock with challan, heat and weight; the ageing view and the close reconciliation compare that balance to receipts and invoices, so the unreconciled INR 3.2 crore position becomes a measured and explainable balance.

Held pending JWK-OQ-6, JWK-OQ-10, IQ-17: The manual triplicate challan becomes a posted system challan and the Excel ITC-04 register is replaced by the ITC-04 statement produced from those posted documents.

openQuestions.question: How does the steel index value reach SAP for the price-variation formula, and may the standard pricing be extended for it in Public Cloud Public Edition inside the INR 2.5 crore budget? Who approves the revised price list before the debit notes are raised?

Part-wise margin is a named output: is the margin report built within this job-work design from standard cost plus billing revenue, or in a separate costing workstream? Which cost estimate frequency and overhead basis apply?

orgStructure.proposal: Company code 1000 for Shaktiman Auto Components Pvt Ltd, holding Bhosari, Hosur and the Chennai warehouse.
Company code 2000 for Shaktiman Forge LLP, holding Chakan where the job-work flow is issued.
